The '''2013–14 New Mexico Lobos men's basketball team''' represented the [[University of New Mexico]] during the [[2013–14 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]] as a member of the [[Mountain West Conference]]. They played their home games at [[The Pit (arena)|The Pit]] in [[Albuquerque]], [[New Mexico]]. The Lobos were led by first year head coach [[Craig Neal]]. They finished the season 27–7, 15–3 in Mountain West play to finish in second place. They were champions of the [[2014 Mountain West Conference men's basketball tournament|Mountain West tournament]], their third consecutive conference tournament championship, to earn an automatic bid to the [[2014 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] where they lost in the second round to Stanford.
